title: Normalized tensor pullback for the actual strict-system inverse image
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $B$ a strict commutative coefficient tower, and $d$ its ordinary system inverse/direct-image adjunction with fixed sectionwise direct image [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data]. Use the closed tensor calculi $\mathcal A_Y,\mathcal A_X$ on the actual unbounded system derived categories [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]. Define tensor pullback data to be a natural isomorphism $d^*(M\otimes^LN)\cong d^*M\otimes^Ld^*N$ equipped with the existing total-complex representative normalization [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Require its ordinary tensor comparison to send the adjunction unit of each local pure tensor on $(n,U)$ to the pure tensor of the two unit sections on $(n,U\times_YX)$. This fixes the ordinary comparison before deriving. The exact inverse-image instances are the ones already in $d$, with no additional exactness or coefficient-flatness assumption. The fixed-coefficient tensor evaluation used with these data is the normalized bridge [def-coef-etale-system-derived-tensor-evaluation].
